parameters.description:
Maximum lag which is included in test, default value of
12*(nobs/100)^{1/4} is used when ``None``.
parameters.name: maxlag

parameters.description:
Constant and trend order to include in regression.

* "c" : constant only (default).
* "ct" : constant and trend.
* "ctt" : constant, and linear and quadratic trend.
* "n" : no constant, no trend.
parameters.name: regression

parameters.description:
Method to use when automatically determining the lag length among the
values 0, 1, ..., maxlag.

* If "AIC" (default) or "BIC", then the number of lags is chosen
  to minimize the corresponding information criterion.
* "t-stat" based choice of maxlag.  Starts with maxlag and drops a
  lag until the t-statistic on the last lag length is significant
  using a 5%-sized test.
* If None, then the number of included lags is set to maxlag.
parameters.name: autolag

parameters.description:
If True, then a result instance is returned additionally to
the adf statistic. Default is False.
parameters.name: store

parameters.description: If True, the full regression results are returned. Default is False.
parameters.name: regresults

parameters.description:
Flag indicating whether to return the results as an
``ADFullerResult`` instead of a plain tuple. If ``None``
(the default), the current tuple-returning behavior is used and a
``FutureWarning`` is issued.

.. deprecated:: 0.15.0

    In release 0.16.0 or after July 2027, whichever is later, the
    default will change to always return an ``ADFullerResult``.
    Set ``result_object=True`` to opt in now, or
    ``result_object=False`` to silence the warning and keep the
    current return type.
parameters.name: result_object

returns.description:
If ``result_object=True``, a result object with fields ``statistic``,
``pvalue``, ``lags``, ``nobs``, ``critical_values``, ``icbest``,
and ``resstore`` (``icbest``/``resstore`` are ``None`` when not
computed). See :class:`~statsmodels.tsa.stattools.ADFullerResult`.

returns.type_doc: Otherwise (the deprecated default), a plain tuple whose length depends
on `store` and `autolag`, made up of a subset of:

returns.description: MacKinnon's approximate p-value based on MacKinnon (1994, 2010).
returns.name: pvalue

returns.description:
The number of observations used for the ADF regression and calculation
of the critical values.
returns.name: nobs

returns.description:
Critical values for the test statistic at the 1 %, 5 %, and 10 %
levels. Based on MacKinnon (2010).
returns.name: critical_values

returns.description: The maximized information criterion if autolag is not None.
returns.name: icbest

returns.description: A dummy class with results attached as attributes.
returns.name: resstore
